balls.text: no, it's s four!! That makes it 12 of the over, and GT get to 210. Mukesh bowls this full and wide of off, and Phillips lofts it by reaching out to go inside out over extra over
looks to reverse scoop, but misses. Then they think of a single, before Tewatia is sent back. The ball was full and wide-ish of off, as Phillips looked to go behind the wicket but missed

direct hit would have had Tewatia!! Axar was at mid-off, and missed despite Tewatia giving up. Mukesh bowled another yorker around off, and Tewatia pushed it back even as Phillips was more than halfway down just as ball hit bat

got him!! Washy falls rather tamely after a very good knock. Mukesh angled this ball in from around the wicket, and bowled a low full toss. Washy opened the face of the bat at that, but only ended up popping it for extra cover
good comeback by Mukesh. He hits back with the yorker just outside off, and Phillips can only bunt this to extra cover
over midwicket. A short-arm pull from Phillips. The ball is on a short of a length on the stumps, and Phillips uses his bottom hand to dump the ball

three fielders dive, but none can stop the ball. First Natarajan, then Stubbs, and then Miller. This is a full ball on off, and Washy drove it back to first beat the bowler, then mid-off, and then long-on running and sliding to his right
bashed over square leg!! Washy nearly falls on his back, but gets to his first IPL fifty. He's deep in the crease, and swipes at this full toss around off.
another attempted yorker. This lands as a low full toss just outside off. Driven to long-on
lovely bowling. Natarajan lands this yorker on off, and Washy, almost as a late resort, ends up dabbing it to short third
tries the scoop, but hits it to short fine leg. Washy gets across early, and Natarajan bowls a lowish full toss wide of off

on the bounce to Stubbs at long-on. It was a low full toss angling across, and Phillips lofted it from middle and off. Phillips gave up after hitting, assuming he was gone, and only ran after he realised he wouldn't be
this dips on to Phillips, and lands as a wide-ish full toss outside off. Driven back to long-on's left
on a fullish length around off, and Phillips can only push it back to Ngidi off an awkward length
this is a wide. Phillips lets it go as Ngidi bowls very full and wide of off
Ngidi welcomes Phillips with a wide yorker. It's a slower ball as well. Phillips reaches out at this dipping ball but misses

taken at short mid-off!! Another one at a lack of pace, and Gill is gone. He went lofting at this full delivery outside off, but seemed to be beaten by the slower ball. Gill opened the face of the bat to try and slice it - perhaps - but ended up skying the ball to where a short mid-off would've been. Rana did well to keep his eyes on it
good ball. This is wide of off, and lands as a deep yorker. Gill looks to slash but misses
starts with a slower ball. On a length on off, and punched wide of long-off
good work by Kuldeep. He moves and tumbles to his left to keep this to a dot. On a length, and wide of off, as Gill swatted it back to him

ohh, wide not given. Kuldeep bowls on a length, and wide-ish of off. Left alone by Gill, who reviews. Kuldeep pitched it around seventh stump, and replays show the ball being just inside the wide line. So it's not a wide
slower, fuller... but six still!! Gill waits for this full and slow ball dip on middle and off, and crashes it back down the ground
bowls thus on a length, and wide of off. The ball turns away further, and Washy follows. Cut away to point in the end
now he goes short and wide of off. Gill reaches out, and swats to long-on
swung away over short fine leg!! Kuldeep bowls short and outside leg, and Gill swivels to ram it back behind the wicket with a pull
very full, and around fifth stump. Washy drills it, but finds the man at extra cover
good delivery. This time Natarajan moves back to the yorker. Gill drags it from off to long-on

wide outside off. Another short delivery, but this one bounces more and ends further of off. Gill looks to ramp but misses. But wait, Axar has reviewed. Natarajan bowled an offcutter, with Gill standing a slight step towards off. The ball leaps and seams away, and is shown to be bang on the revised wide line. Oh, the third umpire says some part of the ball is inside the revised wide line, and that the ball is below head height. So the decision is overturned
between long-on and deep midwicket. Short ball from Natarajan on leg, and the ball seams away to finish on off. It was a slower ball too, but Gill read it and dispatched it with a pull
a full toss swinging in to arrive low on off. Driven down to long-off
bowls a near yorker. Good start. Gill gets across and whips to deep midwicket
Ngidi keeps going at 110kph, and thereabouts. This is another low, dipping full toss, but around sixth stump. Swiped to deep midwicket
swept away to deep square leg. That is Gill's fifty. This ball dips on to him on middle, and meets the bat as a dipping full toss. But Gill reads the lack of pace, and swings at it in the gap
wide of off. Another slower delivery, but Ngidi bowls this from wide of the crease, and ends up going on a fullish length wide of off. Gill lets it go
the dipping slower ball again. This one comes at 111kph. It is nearly a yorker on middle, and Washy pushes it to midwicket
bottom edge, but it goes to the left of the man at short fine leg. Gill advances and has a slash, but the ball dips on to him and arrives as a low full toss just outside off
here comes the slower ball. At just 112kph. Ngidi goes on a length on leg, and Washy ends up tamely fending it towards mid-off
Washy is beaten. Short of a length, and pitching on off. The ball shapes away, and Washy looks to slash but the ball goes over his bat
short in length again, and outside off. Slapped to deep cover. The call was for two, but the pick up and throw was quick
beaten... but it's called wide. Slower from Axar, who goes full and wide of off. Washy looks to sweep but misses

pulled wide of long-on. Stubbs runs and dives to his left, but can't cut it off. Short ball from Axar, whose angle from around the wicket is taking it away from Washy. But the latter pulls from outside off
full and on off, but slower. Driven to deep cover point
on the bounce to fine leg. Washy sweeps this full toss just outside leg, and misses out on a four

nearly taken!! Miller at long-on did very well to run and dive forward, and the ball just dropped off his hands. Gill jumped out and lofted Axar off a length ball, but it went off the inside half of the bat
on a fullish length, and angling across to arrive on off. Punched to long-off
full and straight, and nudged to deep midwicket. "Nice Kuli," says Rahul
Kuldeep tries something different. He goes wide of the crease, and fires this on a fullish length wide of off. Cut away to point
the wrong 'un. Shorter side of a length on leg, and it turns away. Gill punches from off to long-on
bam!! Six over square leg. Gill looks extremely confident with the sweep today. Kuldeep bowls on a length, and around middle and leg. Gill clubs it away after clearing his front leg
short of a length, and angling across to arrive wide of off. Gill slashes away from his body to point
full and slowish on off. Pushed to long-on as the ball hints to turn away
nicely bowled. Pretty slow, and on a fullish length just outside off. Gill has a jab but is beaten on the outside edge
Gill joins the party. Nigam bowls a low full toss on the stumps, and Gill, who has his front leg out of the way, thumps it back over the bowler's head to ping the sightscreen
much fuller and slower this time. This dips on a full length on off, and Washy pushes it to wide long-on
six over deep midwicket!! The change of angle doesn't matter. Short in length yet again, and this one angles into off or thereabouts. Washy clobbers the ball for a six deep into the stands
another short ball, another four. This beats the man at long-on as well, as Washy pulls this ball from outside off in a near carbon-copy way as the last ball. And, and... it's a no-ball too.
this short ball goes for four, though. Washy goes back and opens his stance up at this short ball arriving around sixth stump, and pulls hard and wide of long-on
one bounce to the man at deep midwicket. Nigam bowls short and quick, and on the stumps, and Gill goes back to pull
a yorker-length delivery angling across to arrive on middle. Clipped to deep midwicket
a low full toss on middle and leg. Whipped to deep square leg
pulled over short fine leg. Washy swivels to pull at this short ball rising towards his throat at middle, but gets inside the line of the ball to go over the fielder
short delivery shaping away to finish around sixth stump. Swat-pulled to deep midwicket
the man at point tumbles to his left to keep this to a single, although he doesn't collect it cleanly. Slower ball from Natarajan, who goes on a length and wide of off. Cut away by Washy
skips down, and swats what turns out to be a high-ish full toss around off to long-on
Fuller side of length just outside off, bunted to deep cover
Length on leg, flicked to deep midwicket. GT's hundred is up
Length just outside off, 91ks, skids through as Gill looks to cut it. Has to adjust to the lack of room, gets it through point
Length on off, flicked through square leg
Length on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Kuldeep misses his line, Gill whacks it behind square. His neck's alright. The sweep was what he played when he sprained it during the SA Test too
Short-arm cut, a shot almost unique to Gill. Rises, has the back-lift and contact of a cut but with no follow-through. Hit from shoulder-height to deep point
Length on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Struck well, but long-off stops it. Overpitched slow ball just outside off, driven hard. Timed well, full follow-through and along the ground
Wide on a length, punch-slapped to deep cover
Length outside off, 131ks, punches it with an open face to deep point
Length just outside off, punched to cover
Stubbs beaten this time. TO the right, slid away but Washington's straight drive was quick across the outfield. Just a touch too full from Kuldeep
Two called, long-off keeps it to one. Stubbs chasing it to the left. Wide and full, smothered drive along the ground
Goes back and flicks the length ball to long-on. 84ks

Knocked over, Kuldeep gets Buttler off his third ball. Was a long-hop, but at 95ks after bowling 89ks last two balls, and it didn't bounce. Kept low, lost a lot of pace off the pitch and beat the pull as Buttler got low and tried to adjust. Bottom hand came off as the bails flew
Gets away with a shortish ball outside off, pulled to long-on
Length on leg, looks to flick it leg side. Leading edge goes into the ground and forward
Length on middle, defended to the bowler
Inside out over cover. More square than straight. Opens the face and hits against the angle of the length ball that came in
Length on leg, flicked to deep midwicket
Length on leg, flicked to the right of deep midwicket. Fielder has to run in which allows two. Fifty up for Buttler in 24 balls, five sixes already
Wide on a length, cut to deep point
Length just outside off, punched off the back foot to deep cover.
Buttler keeps strike. Low, wide full toss, Buttler leans and clinks it to mid-off. DC take the timeout as soon as it's available
Pace back on. 123ks but looked quicker. Buttler flicks the length ball to mid-on, who's close. Wanted a run, Gill wisely never took off
Slower yorker just outside off, Buttler looks to drive through cover. Gets an inside edge onto pad and it pops forward
Swat-pulled through midwicket. Dipping low full toss, he had to crouch on impact as he picked it from outside off
Length just outside off, punched to cover
Sees the slower one early, bashes it too but straight to mid-off. Slight fumble but it stays close. Pitched up, driven off the front foot
Short around the helmet, Buttler gets the bat from high to low as he pulls it to deep square leg

This time he opens up the off side. With panache too! Was loading up and then danced down while making room, got a length ball with a bit of width. Created the pace on it by freeing his arms and slapping it over cover
He misses for a change. Makes room and looks to carve a short, wide seam-up ball over middle stump. Was arching back as he played it, ball went over bat.
Gets followed, still flicks it away through midwicket. Clips the length ball from the top of the pads. Buttler on a roll
Whacks the top tier! 96 metres! Sounded like a monster too. Buttler got a slot ball at the stumps, so he got a fast down-swing and muscled it through. Over straight long-on

Oh wow, that is as relaxed as a side-walk scoop can be. Widens his stance, with both feet in the crease, as the bowler delivers the 134ks back of length ball, and lifts the bat as it makes contact with ball
Arm ball on a length at off, punched without weight-transfer, to long-off
Pitched up around off, driven to long-off
Pitched up at the stumps, driven to long-off
Flat length ball on middle, chopped to cover
Looped up, larruped away! Slides his front food leg side, then clubs it golf-style. Hit from well in front of the body. Clears wide long-on with ease
Greeted with... is that a four or a six? Fielder signals four. It's yorked the cushion. Lot of width, a bit too full, Buttler extends his arms and drives it flat over cover
Length around off, punched to mid-off for a quick single

May have hit Rahul's finger, he throws his glove away. That swung after it passed the batter. It hit the fingertips, around the middle finger. He'll get medical assistance. Length ball down leg, Buttler came down and missed a leg glance
Tonks it! And this is vintage Buttler. Walks down, plants his front foot forward before swinging at the full ball coming into him. Through the line, over long-on
Walks into a cover drive, finds the infielder. Got close enough to the pitch there
Length on middle, flicked off the front foot to midwicket. 134ks
Length on the pads, flicked to midwicket

Chopped on, Mukesh points straight and leaps. 133ks seam-up length ball moves in off the pitch, causes Sudharsan to get an under-edge as he looks for a cross-bat square drive. Slices back onto the stumps, the bent elbows show how he's cramped for room. Orthodox batter done in by orthodox seam bowling
A bit of deviation down leg, goes past the attempted pull. Shortish ball at 133ks
Length on middle and off, may have been slow. Yep, 115ks. Flicked towards midwicket
Length at the stumps, flicked to deep square leg. 129ks
Gill sent back, no trouble. Ran halfway back but mid-off had to run a bit too. Pitched up at the stumps, Gill half-flicking past the bowler
A bit wide on a back of length, stirs a cut to cover
Pitched up on leg, flicked to deep midwicket

Punched through cover, so well timed. Sudharsan very still as ball makes contact, high elbows, shape-holding all check. Miller dives to the left, on the practice pitch, and may have grazed his palm. That'll hurt.
Looks to turn it to midwicket, but ball hits bat hard and rolls back to the bowler. Back of length on leg, Gill had to check his shot before closing the bat face
Another flick, stopped by Nissanka at midwicket. Dive to the left, gets his body over it. Length ball on the pads again, shot similar to the first ball
Back of length on off, defended off the front foot to cover point
Deep point in place but has no chance. Races well to his right. Gill stays back and gently cuts it, uses his wrist and steers it with an almost vertical bat.
A bit of width, carved. The length ball just outside off goes to deep third
No swing, too straight, clipped away. Length ball on the pads, flicked late, as the ball approached the top of the pad

Have GT have won by one run?! This is an amazing finish. The umpire has given Kuldeep run-out, but hang on... this could be wide for height. Plenty is happening even as GT look confident. The players are lurking on the field, waiting for the final decision. Ohh, the ball passes below Miller's head, although he's "on his toes", as per the third umpire. More wait. More nerves. More drama. If it's not a wide, GT will win by one run. Indeed. The ball passes well below the head height. So it's not a wide. So it's confirmed: GT win by one run. This was the delivery: Prasidh bowled a slower one, and short in length. Miller looked to pull but missed. The ball shaped away just before landing into Buttler's gloves. Miller and Kuldeep ran, but the latter fell short despite diving as Buttler hit the stumps at his end
ohhh, he sends Kuldeep back. Dot ball for GT. Wow, Miller will need two off one ball. Short ball, and he pulled from middle to deep-backward square leg

this lands out of the ground!! A few hundred miles over long-off. Gill looks away. We'll need a new ball. Miller gets a length delivery outside off, and he liberally lofts it through the line. He got the pace and the length to go for it.
a loud cheer from the crowd as Kuldeep takes the single. Short delivery just outside off, and Kuldeep guides it to deep third

taken by Gill!! More importantly for GT, Miller will remain off strike. More drama. A short ball from Prasidh, who bowls a cutter outside off. The ball shapes back in, and Nigam decides to swat it back after making room. But he can only send it up for Gill to take it after moving a few steps back from extra cover
over mid-off. Why do you need a Miller when a Nigam is on song?! He's deep in the crease, and slices this length ball on the stumps. There's no long-off, and Nigam has all the room to swing his arms
Nigam backs away, and Siraj follows. It ends up being a high-ish full toss way outside leg. Nigam whips to fine leg, even as I thought they wouldn't run

four for Nigam!! All Buttler can do is watch the ball sail over his head. Bouncer from Siraj, and this pitches outside off but ends on middle. There's a man at deep third, but the late upper cut is late enough for Nigam to get four
short ball again. This pitches outside leg, and Miller pulls after the ball finishes on middle. Single to deep midwicket

Miller doesn't even need to look. He still gets six. His eyes are facing the ground, even as the ball has found its way into the sky. Full delivery around middle, and thumped back over long-on for six more. Who would believe Miller had hurt his hand while both fielding and batting?!

six more?! I think it landed bang on the boundary cushion. But the third umpire will confirm. Siraj went full this time, but the line was wide of off. Miller launched the ball forcefully, and went over extra cover. We're still waiting for confirmation regarding it was a four or six. Oh, it's four.
pumped over deep midwicket!! Short ball pitching on leg, and shaping away. Miller picks it up from wide-ish of off, and rams the pull for six
wide ball. Siraj angles it across, and goes on a yorker length wide of off. Left alone by Miller
short again, and pulled from middle to fine leg. There's a cry from Miller, possibly on hitting the ball straight to the fielder
crashed over extra cover. Short delivery finishing on off, and he waits before tennis-batting the ball over the in-field
this time Nigam backs away. Short ball outside off, and swatted to long-on
gets across the stumps, and looks to scoop, but misses. Rabada saw the batter moving, and bowled it short and wide of off. The ball went over Nigam in the end
lands between point and deep point running towards each other. A short-of-a-length ball outside off, and Nigam sliced it aerially
short ball on middle, and shapes away. Pulled to deep midwicket

got him!! Rahul falls for 92. This could be the game for GT. Rahul chases a wide delivery, and falls. A cross-seam delivery from Siraj, who bowls on a yorker length and wide outside off. Rahul had left the previous wide balls outside off this over, but not this time. He has a swing at it, and ends up getting an outside edge for Buttler
there's no long-on, and Rahul spots that. One bounce, and four. But Phillips from deep midwicket gives it his all while running to his left. A full delivery around off, and Rahul lofts it over mid-on
one more. Yorker length as the ball swings away to land wide of off. Rahul lets it go
wide delivery. Rahul leaves it alone, as it is very full and wide of off

direct hit, and Stubbs is gone!! Sai was at mid-on, and had a lot of time to aim at the bowler's end as Stubbs had taken off. But Stubbs was sent back after running halfway down, and even a dive couldn't save him. Siraj bowled another bouncer at Rahul, who swatted at it from around off stump. The ball only went as far as mid-on, though, and Stubbs ran without looking back
wow, Siraj bowls a bouncer and Rahul looks for the reverse swat but misses. The ball pitches wide-ish of off, and away from Rahul's range
Rashid saves three runs. He's at mid-off, and throws himself to his right to get a hand. Stubbs drilled this full ball outside off, but only got one
good take by Washy. He was at deep backward point, and took the ball on the bounce even as it spun away from him. Rahul sliced a low full toss outside off, and didn't find the gap
beaten by the change of pace. Ashok goes full at 105kph, and around sixth stump. Stubbs has a punch but misses

high full toss on middle, and punched to long-on. It's not given no-ball for height, so Rahul reviews. Oh, the first replay shows Rahul played it from below the waist, but we'll see. Yup, he has played it well below his waist height. So it's a fair delivery

Sai at long-on turns into Phillips, but neither can he catch nor can he save four. Length ball at a lack of pace outside off, and Rahul flings at it. Sai dives forward, and the ball falls well short of him, before popping up off his hands for four

well bowled. Then there's a direct hit. Then there's an overthrow... for four. So it's five off the ball. Wow, Ashok fired a yorker on off, only for it to cost five. Stubbs jammed it down towards mid-off, from where Gill threw at the striker's end. It hit the stumps, and ricocheted for four
back of a length, and just outside off. Back to pace on at 143kph. Punched to extra cover
goes full, but wide of off. The length is very full, but Rahul lets it go
four first ball after the break. Ashok bowls from wide of the crease, and short on middle. Rahul beats short fine leg to his left after pulling it away
Stubbs wants a single, but lets it be. Rabada bowls short on middle, and hits Stubbs on leg as the latter opens his stance up to nudge
short ball just outside off, and Stubbs looks to pull but is beaten by the pace and movement back in
It's Phillips at deep midwicket, and he flies to his right to take it on the bounce. Rahul pulls a bouncer from outside off, and his top hand comes off the bat. Just a single in the end
on a length on off, and punched to long-on
short ball a little wide off, and at a lack of pace. Rahul rolls his wrists to pull to deep midwicket
bang!! Four over the bowler's head. The length is full enough for him to simply hit through the line. He targets this ball on off, and sends it sailing back down the ground
wide ball. Rabada angles it in, and lands it full and outside leg. Rahul looked to flick but missed

Phillips does what he does best - takes a good catch!! Rashid went across the stumps, and bowled from around the wicket. It pitched on a full length on off, and Rashid bowled the wrong 'un. Axar went lofting by opening the face of his bat, but ended up slicing it for Phillips, who, at extra cover, turned around and dived, with the ball dropping over his head. It was a nice grab as he kept his eyes on the ball and timed his dive perfectly
again bowls very full, and this is quicker too. Flicked from middle to deep midwicket
quite full and straight, and pushed back to Rashid
on a length on off, and punched to cover point
on a few bounces to Washy at fine leg. Rahul sweeps this full ball on middle and off by going down
full and tossed up on middle. Driven to long-on
and he gets it. Rahul goes over extra cover. He stands deep in the crease, and lofts this inside out. Prasidh bowls a full delivery outside off, and Rahul forcefully goes after the ball
nearly a yorker, and on middle. Miller clips to deep midwicket this time
much fuller and slower. Miller flicks it late to wide long-on, and picks two
on the bounce to short fine leg. He swivels to pull another short ball, but doesn't find the gap this time

four to deep midwicket. The pull wasn't timed all that convincingly, but it still came off. In fact, he was wringing his left hand after pulling it away. Short ball just outside off, and he went after it
a full toss on off, and whipped to deep-backward square leg
keeps mixing it up. Another slower ball at 110kph. This is on a length, and around sixth stump. Swatted back towards extra cover
short of a length, and just outside off. Pace on this time, and punched to mid-of for a hurried single

very wide. In fact, the umpire's wondering if it's even a no-ball for landing outside the pitch. Nope, it's called a wide. Ashok went for the slower ball on a short of a length, and around 15th stump. Miller let it go
change of pace. Short of a length around off at 103kph, and nudged to midwicket

bottom edge, and they push for the single. There was a throw at the bowler's end even as Miller dived. The throw was wide, though. Miller went for the pull off this short-of-a-length ball shaping in, but played a bit early
extra bounce for Ashok. He bowls this slower, and goes for a bouncer wide-ish of off. Miller looks to pull but is beaten
short in length, and just outside off. Pulled powerfully to long-on
this skids through and strikes Miller, but the lbw appeal for Washy is turned down. On a length on middle, and that seemed to be heading down with the angle as Miller looked to clip but missed
on a length on leg, and he goes back to clip to deep-backward square leg for two
shorter side of a length on the stumps, and turning in. Punched to long-on
full and flat, and just outside off. Driven to square leg off the inside half of the bat
short of a length, and just outside off. Swatted to long-off
but nothing matters for Rahul!! He sends the ball up a few hundred metres, and lands it beyond the long-on boundary. Down the track, and converts this into a length ball for a free swing of the arms

POTM... not today. Ripping googly from Rashid. Lands just outside off and spins in sharply, Rizvi covered the initial line as he went for the punch through mid-off. Beaten on the inside edge, off stump dinked

High ball... Sudharsan runs in takes it beautifully! Running in from long-off, took the catch as he went down to slide, then tumbled and turned to get up in style. Was a 95ks length ball outside off that Rana swiped across the line. Top edge. Small innings, eventful but not impactful
Short and it's pulled over midwicket. Spun in towards off, Rana swivelled and powered it flat. Nice jump to finish
Length on leg, beats the flick and hits the pad

Reverse sweep missed, big lbw appeal. Given! DC review. Length ball went over the bat and looked to have hit him just over the right glove. Ultra-Edge shows a spike as the ball's just over the bat. So Rana survives
Full on leg, 95ks, flicked to short fine leg
Rahul takes on the best bowler in the opposition and gets to fifty. Removes his gloves and rocks on with a celebration. This had width and the shortness, carved through backward point
Pace-on and an even better shot! Inside out over wide long-off. Overpitched outside of, Rahul doesn't move his feet much, knows he's close to the ball and drives with a slightly open face
Waits for and muscles the slower one. 100ks offcutter is on the fuller side just outside off, Rahul stays leg side of the ball and swings straight. 74-metres six
Deep square leg is close but has no chance. One bounce four to his left. Was a shortish ball around rib-height, pace-on, Rahul swivelled and pulled it flat
Looks to crush it across the line, the fullish ball goes off the inside-half of the bat to deep square leg

Prasidh continues his wicket-taking ways. Bowls hard length just outside off with a slightly scrambled seam, it's a bit too close and short for the flat-bat slash across the line. Mid-off takes a low catch. Nissanka tosses his bat forward and spins it as GT celebrate
Length ball lands on leg and goes in, flicked through midwicket
Looped at 88ks, full too, driven just over the infield and to long-on
Shaped for the cut but that kept coming in, Rahul finished almost playing a flick to the 89ks length ball. Hits high on the bat and lands nearby
Pitched up on leg, flicked to long-on
Pitched up on off, defended towards cover.
Length just outside off, 88ks, cut to deep point
Width offered and that's slapped over extra cover. GT lucky that didn't land over the ropes. Hard length allows Rahul to flay it with a flat bat
Length outside off, mix of a cut and a back-foot drive through cover. 141ks
Length down leg, beats the leg glance and goes off the pad to the keeper. 137ks
Pitched up on middle at 142ks, flicked through backward square leg
Length on middle and leg, 137ks, Nissanka looks to flick through midwicket. Leading edge goes into the the pitch in front
Length around off, flicked to midwicket
Slower one... still guided wide of short third. That's a use-the-pace shot. Length outside off, Nissanka taps it on the head. Timeout
Met with again. 148ks length ball just outside off, clobbered across the line with a clean swing. Over midwicket

Comes in at pace, same for going away. 147ks but a bit too full, Nissanka's beside the ball and drives through the line. High back-lift, bat-path was almost from first slip through mid-on but the face opened on impact and it went straight
Slower one picked. Nissanka also makes room, has to fetch as the full ball was outside off. Managed to get it with a side-swipe over extra cover
Low full toss on leg, flicked to deep square leg. 147ks

Even Phillips can't chase that. Bottom edge went very high and going away towards the point boundary. Phillips went out from the infield and dove forward, couldn't get fingertips on it. 143ks hard-length ball on off, Rahul made room and carved it
Length on off, punched to long-off
Warne-like spin. Angles in and lands towards off before snaking away fiercely. Rahul didn't chase it, kept the bat on pad while shaping to defend to cover. Happily beaten. Rashid smiles
Into the pitch at 89ks, on middle but Nissanka happy to play a cross-batted pull through midwicket
Driven into a length at 90ks, on the pads, whipped off the back foot to long-on. CLeared the front leg too
96ks length ball on leg, swept on the rise to deep midwicket
Googly snakes back off a length towards leg stump, cut to cover point. 87ks
Rabada's missing a few yorkers, bowls a shin-high full toss that's driven to cover
Deserved more than a dot. 147ks hard-length ball was flat-batted, Rahul forced momentum against the ball and timed it well. Found mid-off
Picked up over the DC dugout at square leg. Too full and on the pads, Rahul bends his back leg a touch, closes the face as he swings from back to front
Helped off the back foot to deep fine leg

Full toss slips a touch high, almost creates a wicket. Rahul wanted to lift it behind square. He wasn't fully upright and the ball was rearing at him, so he removed his bottom hand and lifted it with a straight bat. Ball landed safely behind square with fielders converging
Not too short, pulled through square leg
Length on middle and leg, punched to mid-on
Down leg, Buttler takes it low with one hand. Length ball goes down with the angle, past the leg glance
Beaten. Back of lengther well outside off but the bounce is a touch low. Rahul takes a step across and looks to cut hard over cover.
Wide again and that flies. It's swinging off the fuller side of length, but in Rahul's reach. He opens the face and lifts it over mid-off
Followed as he made room. Got a length ball that he flicked to midwicket
Slower one goes under the bat. Oh no, that's 134ks. Back of length ball died down after hitting the pitch, Rahul went for the pull
Pitched up at the stumps, driven over the bowler. Lands at the edge of the outfield, long-off runs left to stop it
Beaten on the cut. 145ks outswinger hits a hard length and goes away outside off. Nissanka, with planted feet, tried to go through point
Length outside off, looks to punch through cover with a mostly horizontal bat. Under-edge, on the bounce to the keeper
Tries first up and fails. Pre-meditated scoop aimed fine, got his front leg outside off and showed all three stumps. Was on one knee, the back of length ball went down leg
Cut to deep point. Wide on a length, Rahul getting low and middling it
Smacked over wide long-on. Rahul's ready for the fullness in length. Takes a small stride forward and swings the bat from third through mid-on. Full follow-through
Length on top of middle and leg, same pace, defended with a closing bat-face towards midwicket
Stopped at midwicket. Flicks the 141ks full ball off the front foot
Man is Nissanka in touch! This is an authoritative straight drive. Small stride forward, got the hands down quickly and continued the swing till around rib-height. Held his shape for the snappers
Swings away. Guided with the swing to deep-backward point. Didn't move his feet, opened the face and patted the length ball with a vertical bat
Length outside off, guided to deep third
Takes a step down and goes over the bowler. Got the ball beside him and then drove through the line. Ball just in front of him. Maintained full control even after connecting
Too full and wide, Nissanka thrashes it through cover. Diagonal-bat drive, hit with ball next to his back leg and with the swing
Touch back of length outside off, cut with the swing to cover point
